title: The gateway is on. Readings stopped.
subtitle: An IoT gateway is connected to a computer on site
voice: The gateway has power, but new readings stopped. Diagnose lets your AI investigate remotely.

title: Connect the device and start the probe
subtitle: On-site computer · USB data cable · Node.js 20.10 or later
voice: On site, connect the gateway by USB and start the probe. Choose permissions, then share the nine-letter invitation privately.

title: Start in the agent you already use
subtitle: One-time native skill installation · Codex, Claude Code, or Gemini CLI
voice: Install the Diagnose skill once. In your agent, invoke it and paste the invitation with a description of the problem.

title: The on-site user controls access
subtitle: The probe shows a confirmation prompt when the chosen mode requires it
voice: Here, the user confirms the connection once. Tasks and results proceed under their chosen permission mode.

title: The computer connects the agent to the device
subtitle: The relay forwards encrypted commands and results between the two computers
voice: An encrypted relay connects the computers. The probe is now reachable. The agent still needs to check the gateway.

title: Check the gateway and follow the evidence
subtitle: Read-only investigation · Inspect the port, sample output, then read the collector settings
voice: The gateway is sending readings on its current USB port, but the collector still uses the old port. The agent explains the mismatch.

title: Apply one authorized correction
subtitle: Update the on-site collector setting after reviewing the change
voice: The site user agrees to update the collector's port. The agent records the old setting and applies the correction.

title: Check the reading in the dashboard
subtitle: Repeat the original check and confirm a fresh device value arrives
voice: A new gateway reading reaches the dashboard. The agent reports what changed and the user can review the local audit history.

title: Start your first diagnosis
subtitle: User guide and device walkthroughs
voice: Try a manual session first. For repeat work, launch with a device procedure.
